description: This file defines classes related to grain bindings and their resolution within the Orleans framework. It includes the GrainBindings class, which encapsulates binding information for a grain type, and the GrainBindingsResolver class, which manages the retrieval and caching of these bindings based on cluster manifests.

classes.name: GrainBindings
classes.description: Represents the bindings associated with a specific grain type, including the grain type itself and its binding properties.

classes.name: GrainBindingsResolver
classes.description: Provides functionality to resolve, cache, and retrieve grain bindings based on cluster manifests, supporting both specific and generic grain types.

methods.name: GetBindings
methods.description: Retrieves the bindings for a specified grain type, resolving generic types if necessary.

methods.name: GetAllBindings
methods.description: Returns all grain bindings along with their cluster manifest version.

methods.name: GetCache
methods.description: Manages cache retrieval and refresh based on cluster manifest version.

methods.name: BuildCache
methods.description: Constructs a cache of grain bindings from the cluster manifest.
